bgm.query: driving minimal tech, tight percussive pulse, rising energy, no vocals

trim.reason: The library track opened on a 15s quiet build at -28 dB mean, 16 dB under the body of the track — it would have drained the whole sizzle. The drop lands at 15.66s, so the track is trimmed from there: frame 1 sits on the downbeat at full energy (-12.8 dB) and holds through the cut, with a 1.2s tail fade.

_sfx_plan.note: HeyGen retrieval returned cues far longer than their frames (a 39.6s keystroke bed on a 2.6s frame, a 7.0s tick pattern whose 1.0s spacing did not match the 0.47s token cycle). Each file is clipped to its actual beat window; originals kept in assets/sfx/raw/. The riser peaks at its end and is placed to land its peak exactly on the 10.0s UP cut, so frame 4's dead-still beat plays as loaded silence under a build.
